ClassB.label: CONFIRMED

ClassB.detail: Depth store vs layout-transition WRITE-AFTER-WRITE src-scope gap in Image::GetBarriers on depth 0x104f080000/0x104ee78000. Fixed by promoting the depth-write stage/access into the generated src scope for is_depth images in a depth-attachment layout, both emit branches (FEAT-003). renderpass-barrier-test prints 'depth transition ordered after the depth store (WRITE-AFTER-WRITE count = 0)'; red without the fix.

ClassC.label: CONFIRMED BEHAVIOR
ClassC.proof: BEHAVIOR confirmed in code + demonstrated at runtime in the earlier FEAT-004 run (Flip #420, 20 STALLED / 0 SKIPPED visible draws) when memory headroom existed
ClassC.detail: GetGraphicsPipeline returned nullptr for two reasons (pending async compile vs failed compile) and the rasterizer null-pipeline guard collapsed them, silently dropping the draw -> objects/lights pop in/out while shaders compile. Fixed by key-scoped WaitGraphics (stall exactly one visible pending draw on exactly one compile) + a never-silent skip/stall log (FEAT-004). Which specific objects this fixes remains HYPOTHESIS as designed; the drop->stall mechanism and its stable-ID linkage are confirmed.
